label: Ownership
short: A named person who fields questions about whether an AI tool may be used for a task.
strong: Someone's role includes being asked. Check it has time attached.
middle: One enthusiast everyone asks is a single point of failure. If that person is you, the role has no cover. The hiring pack sets out the three ways to fix it.
edge: Nobody is asked, so nobody answers, so staff decide alone. The hiring pack sets out the three ways to fix it.
unmet: If nobody can say who this is, it is nobody.
